title: clarification
description: The claim author answers objections. Broadcast so other validators read it before filing the same objection. A clarification supersedes every objection that preceded it.

seq.description: Objections are counted only from this point forward. A validator still unsatisfied re-files against this number.

detail.description: The answer. It explains what was already submitted and changes nothing: the claim hash covers what was committed, so amending it would break the commitment every validator is checking against. Evidence that was missing is added by an `amendment`, which is separately signed and additive.
